messages:
jen: heads-up from SRE — the console's 'Auto fallback' setting is tripping people up. they toggled it and traffic went to backup but there was no obvious audit entry. link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1723 :eyes:
akash: ugh. do we know if they changed the policy or a rollout rule triggered it?
maria: they said the UI text made them think it was a full switch. in reality they had 'silent' degrade + sample 1%. toggle just showed ON, no summary.
sam: quick wins: (1) update toggle copy, (2) show summary pill next to toggle with mode/sample/triggers, (3) add a concise audit event when policy is changed.
akash: backend already stores the policy JSON. example: { "policy_id": "pf-8a3", "enabled": true, "mode": "silent", "sample_pct": 1, "triggers": ["latency_over_1s", "5xx_rate>2%"] } we emit full policy-change events today but not a human-friendly line in the UI.
maria: also add a tiny "why did I fallback?" link near results that opens sampled decisions aggregated by reason (counts + top reasons), not raw per-request logs. SRE just wants a quick explanation.
jen: priority P2. SRE wants a dev-preview before next week's demo. can we scope a small PR: pill UI + audit entry that contains user, env, mode, sample, triggers?
sam: I can build the pill and the edit chevron. will mock the microcopy.
akash: I'll add an audit event emitter in the policy update endpoint and push to event-log stream. will include user email + req_id. ops-bot: notified: evt-8234 created (dev) to emit compact policy-change events.
maria: I'll post the pill copy in #design in 45m. suggested copy: "Auto fallback — silent · sample=1% · triggers: latency, 5xx" with a tooltip that expands details. :memo:
jen: acceptance test: when a policy-change call happens, UI should surface an audit line: "Auto fallback ENABLED (silent, sample=1%, triggers=[latency_over_1s, 5xx_rate>2%]) by jen@redwood". include test to assert exact fields.
akash: will add tests + open PR and link to INF-1723. also update openapi to document extra audit payload.
sam: small note: we sample decision logs at 0.1% currently. don't change that now. the aggregated link will read from sampled decisions for the timeframe.
maria: UX follow-up: if mode is "silent" show a clear label "silent (no user-visible fallback)" in the pill. avoids people assuming user-facing behavior.
jen: cool. timeline: mock -> PR by Wed, dev-preview by Thu, SRE validation Fri. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
